meta.title: Currency Converter - S-Jiffy
meta.description: Real-time currency exchange rate converter. Convert between 30+ currencies with live rates updated daily.
steps_currency-converter_1Desc: Input the amount, select source and target currencies from 170+ world currencies. Exchange rates are fetched live for accurate conversion.
steps_currency-converter_2Desc: The converted amount displays instantly based on current exchange rates. The rate used and last update time are shown for transparency.
steps_currency-converter_3Desc: Click Copy to grab the converted amount. Note: displayed rates are for reference — always verify with your bank before making large transactions.
